mainEntity.name: How long does a premium pool-deck installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a premium pool-deck installation varies based on the deck's size, complexity, and the chosen materials. A typical project might range from 2 to 6 weeks from ground preparation to final touches. This timeline includes demolition of existing surfaces, sub-base preparation, material delivery, installation, and any necessary curing times. Factors like custom features, intricate designs, or unforeseen site conditions can extend the project. We provide a detailed project schedule before commencing work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a premium pool deck typically ranges from 2 to 6 weeks, depending on size, complexity, and materials. A detailed schedule is provided upfront.
